title: Case: Customer receives another customer's parcel
context: A customer holds a parcel that is not theirs. Carrier staff will collect it using an internal label match; the customer need not open it or deliver it elsewhere.
initial_request: The courier left someone else’s parcel. It is unopened. Can you arrange collection? My own order has not arrived.

events.body: Inline minimised carrier intake record MD-2798: wrong parcel matched to internal label reference WP-4059; reporting customer Lorcan Grimshaw and collection address verified in the carrier intake process. Do not copy the other recipient’s address into this thread. Collection is allowed from the reporting customer.
The courier left someone else’s parcel. It is unopened. Can you arrange collection? My own order has not arrived.
Please collect sealed parcel WP-4059 from Lorcan using MD-2798’s verified address and saved contact. Do not ask Lorcan to open or forward it. Track their own outstanding order separately.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Misdelivery collections, Glimmerton Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Collection of the wrong parcel does not fulfil the reporting customer’s own order.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-027: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
